# SourceBadge

A neutral badge naming where a track was heard or found (a radio show, tracklist site, chart or store), with "+N" opening the full list.

`SongNodes.SourceBadge` · Data

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.SourceBadge sources={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.SourceBadge" sources="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sources` * | `{ name: string; kind: "radio" \| "list" \| "chart" \| "store"; detail?: string; when?: string }[]` | Where the track was heard or found, most relevant first. |
| `max` | `number` | How many sources to show before "+N" (default 1). |
